listing.title: Trainee Territory Business Manager - Mumbai (Fresher)

job.descriptionTeaser: Job Function: Sales Roles and Responsibilities in detail : •To be able to follow up, monitor sales in the territory •Implementation & execution of all strategies •Stakeholder engagement- doctors, stoc

ml_job_overview.summary: The Trainee Territory Business Manager - Mumbai (Fresher) role is designed for recent graduates with a science background who are eager to launch their careers in sales. This position focuses on supporting the implementation and execution of sales strategies within a defined territory, engaging with stakeholders such as doctors, stockiers, retailers, and pharmacy institutions. The role requires strong communication and analytical skills, as well as the ability to adapt to changing market conditions. Candidates will be expected to manage customer relationships, execute customer management plans, and contribute to business development. This is an excellent opportunity for individuals seeking to build a career in sales within the healthcare sector.
skills: Demonstrate strong communication skills in English and the local language.
Show proficiency in basic computer skills, including Excel, Word, and email exchanges.
Exhibit adaptability and a fast learning ability to respond to changes in the market.
Possess a basic understanding of anatomy, physiology, and the product portfolio.
Have experience in customer management and business development.
responsibilities: Responsible for following up and monitoring sales performance within the assigned territory.
Take ownership of implementing and executing all sales strategies.
Collaborate cross-functionally to engage with stakeholders including doctors, stockiers, retailers, chemists, and pharmacy institutions.
Deliver high-quality customer management by executing customer management plans to ensure all customers are covered as per the plan.
Play a key role in shaping business generation and development through science-based discussions with doctors and chemists.
Help drive innovation in in-clinic performance and adapt quickly to changes in the market.
education: A science graduate qualification is required.

job.ai_summary: The Trainee Territory Business Manager - Mumbai (Fresher) role focuses on sales monitoring, strategy execution, and stakeholder engagement across various sectors, including doctors, stockiers, and pharmacies. Responsibilities include implementing sales strategies, managing customer relationships, and supporting business development. Candidates must be freshers with good communication and analytical skills, and hold a science degree. Basic computer proficiency, particularly in Excel and Word, is required. The role demands adaptability, punctuality, and effective verbal communication in English and the local language. Experience in in-clinic performance and the ability to generate business are essential. The position is on business partner payroll.

ml_job_overview.summary: The Therapy Business Manager | GI Prima at ABLAUS31152736ZHGLOBALEXTERNAL is responsible for managing and promoting Abbott’s products within the GI therapy division in India. This role focuses on building and maintaining relationships with doctors and chemists, ensuring product coverage, and driving sales through effective engagement and market intelligence. The position requires regular audits of prescriptions, execution of customer management plans, and participation in various company activities to enhance job performance. The successful candidate will demonstrate professional behaviour aligned with Abbott’s values and adhere to company policies. Compensation and benefits are not specified in the job description.
responsibilities: Create and maintain an updated list of doctors and chemists, ensuring it meets the specific requirements of the therapy or product.
Conduct regular visits to doctors and chemists to promote Abbott’s products, provide product information, engage in science-based discussions, and address any queries.
Achieve sales targets by effectively promoting products and driving prescription generation.
Conduct regular audits of prescriptions for Abbott and competitor brands to gather market intelligence and adjust strategies accordingly.
Organise Camps (CME) as per the division strategy and customers’ needs.
Continuously monitor actual sales performance, making necessary adjustments to strategies to minimise variances from targets.
Prescription audit for Abbott brands and other competitor brands.
Execute the customer management plan to ensure that all the customers are covered as per the plan.
Demonstrate and promote professional behaviour aligned with Abbott’s values of Pioneering, Achieving, Caring, and Enduring.
Participate in strategy meetings, briefing sessions, doctors’ meets, workshops, training programmes, and other company activities to enhance job performance and promote product sales.
skills: Fluent and confident in communication is required.
Candidates with prior or current experience in the same therapy are preferred.
Experience in the same therapy is considered an advantage.
Candidates from multinational companies and top Indian pharmaceutical companies will have added advantages.

job.ai_summary: The Therapy Business Manager at Abbott in India is responsible for managing and promoting Abbott’s products to doctors and chemists, maintaining up-to-date lists, and achieving sales targets. Key duties include conducting regular visits, promoting products, conducting audits, and gathering market intelligence. The role also involves organising CMEs, monitoring sales performance, and ensuring customer coverage. Candidates must have at least two years’ experience in the relevant therapy, strong communication skills, and prior experience in the same area. Experience in multinational companies or top Indian pharmaceuticals is advantageous. The position requires adherence to Abbott’s values and strict compliance with the Code of Business Conduct.

job.description:
Roles and Responsibilities in detail

  • Create and maintain an updated list of doctors and chemists, ensuring it meets the specific requirements of the therapy/product.
  • Conduct regular visits to doctors and chemists to promote Abbott’s products, provide product information, engage in science-based discussions, and address any queries
  • Achieve sales targets by effectively promoting products and driving prescription generation.
  • Conduct regular audits of prescriptions for Abbott and competitor brands to gather market intelligence and adjust strategies accordingly.\
  • Organizing Camps (CME) as per the division strategy and customers need.
  • Continuously monitor actual sales performance, making necessary adjustments to strategies to minimize variances from targets.
  • Prescription audit for Abbott brands and other competitor’s brands
  • Execute the customer management plan to ensure that all the customers are covered as per the plan.
  • Demonstrate and promote professional behavior aligned with Abbott’s values of Pioneering, Achieving, Caring, and Enduring.

  • Participate in strategy meetings, briefing sessions, doctors’ meets, workshops, training programs, and other company activities to enhance job performance and promote product sales.

  • Adhere strictly to Abbott’s Code of Business Conduct

Meet minimum KPIs as follows:

  • 100% coverage of Doctors.
  • Customer Call average as per the customer management plan of the division /therapy.
  • Market intelligence collection, retailer level inventory management calls as per the product profile and marketing strategy of the therapy /division.

Experience/Training Required

  • 2+ Years of experience.
  • Candidate with prior/current experience in the same therapy.
  • Candidates from MNC and top Indian Pharma companies will have added advantages.
  • Fluent and confident in communication.
